name: 01-title-menu
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Premium polished videogame UI concept for Virtual Runners, a joyful 1990s anime side-scrolling runner with existing cel-painted chibi characters. Brand '晴空跑道': bright open SKY, CLOUD WHITE and SUNSHINE ORANGE. Palette #23B5E8, #116F95, #FF8A3D, #FFFFFF, #ECF8FC, dark text #163A4B, reward yellow #F5C949. Rounded wayfinding signs, circular route nodes, pill-shaped distance markers, thin deep-lake-blue outlines and soft short shadows. Clear spacious hierarchy, large readable Traditional Chinese, functional consistent UI. Flat cel colors, no chrome or metallic letters, no black brush panels, no volleyball/sports-team shield, no navy-gold theme, no app-store ad/purchases, no floating confetti everywhere. Clean typography, no illegible tiny labels. Full-bleed landscape 16:9 screen, preferably 1920x1080 or higher, no device frame. References: image1 is approved branding, UI shapes, typography and logo. Images2-4 are EXACT character identities/outfits: teal twin ponytail schoolgirl Xiaocui, black-haired red-jacket boy Aming, orange-ponytail blue-athletic girl Xiaochun. Create a complete beautiful TITLE MENU screen. Huge airy cyan sky, white clouds, a sunlit white city and a winding elevated stone running path receding into distant green hills. Top left clear sky contains the logo '虛擬跑跑樂' and 'VIRTUAL RUNNERS', same lettering and colors as image1, about 42% screen width. Right middle: three referenced chibi heroes sprint RIGHT together joyfully, Xiaocui foreground, other two slightly behind. Entire bodies visible, preserve clothes and hairstyles. NO fighting or ball sports. Central-left scenery remains airy, route links the scene to bottom navigation. Bottom 26% is a clean pale sky dock, horizontal menu: largest orange rounded route sign '單機遊玩' with small '開始冒險' and arrow, second white/blue sign '開設房間', third white/blue '加入房間', two compact labeled utility controls '操作說明' and '設定'. Exactly these five menu functions. Bottom-left tiny but legible keyboard/gamepad hints '選擇' '確認'. One selected orange button, no repeating all-orange buttons. Screen looks like a real polished game title, not a presentation board. Bright relaxing scene plus energetic running; wide readability, no text over faces, no event/shop/rewards tabs.
